# `@0xdolan/deq-core` API

The reference renderer for Deq shapes. Pure ESM, no DOM, no I/O. See the
[package README](../../packages/core/README.md) for an introduction.

## Functions

### `compose`

```ts
function compose(parts: readonly CompositionPart[], options?: RenderOptions): string
```

Render several catalog shapes placed on one 24 x 24 canvas. Stroke widths and dot radii
are not scaled. `options.params` is not used (give each part its own `params`).

**@throws** {DeqError} `INVALID_OPTIONS`, `UNKNOWN_SHAPE` or `INVALID_PARAMETER`.

### `escapeXml`

```ts
function escapeXml(s: string): string
```

Escape text for XML character data and double-quoted attributes; drop invalid characters.

### `expand`

```ts
function expand(id: string, params?: Readonly<Record<string, ParamValue>>): Flat[]
```

Expand the catalog shape `id` into flat geometry.

### `expandShape`

```ts
function expandShape(shape: ShapeData, params?: Readonly<Record<string, ParamValue>>): Flat[]
```

Expand `shape` into flat geometry with the given parameter values.

### `getShape`

```ts
function getShape(id: string): ShapeData
```

The shape with this id. Throws `DeqError` (`UNKNOWN_SHAPE`) with suggestions otherwise.

### `hasShape`

```ts
function hasShape(id: string): boolean
```

True when a shape with this id exists.

### `listCategories`

```ts
function listCategories(): readonly string[]
```

Category ids in catalog order.

### `listShapes`

```ts
function listShapes(category?: string | undefined): readonly ShapeData[]
```

Every shape, in catalog order, optionally only one category.

### `num`

```ts
function num(x: number): string
```

Format a number with at most 3 decimals: `roundHalfEven(x * 1000)` thousandths, printed
without trailing zeros, without a leading `+`, and with `-0` as `0`.

### `render`

```ts
function render(id: string, options?: RenderOptions): string
```

Render the catalog shape `id` as a standalone SVG string.

```ts
render("roj-half-sun", { size: 48, strokeWidth: 1.5, color: "#ED2024", params: { rays: 9 } });
```

**@throws** {DeqError} `UNKNOWN_SHAPE`, `INVALID_OPTIONS` or `INVALID_PARAMETER`.

### `renderShapeData`

```ts
function renderShapeData(shape: ShapeData, options?: RenderOptions): string
```

Render a shape description (already validated) to an SVG string.

### `resolveOptions`

```ts
function resolveOptions(options?: unknown): ResolvedOptions
```

Validate `options` and fill in defaults. Throws `DeqError` (`INVALID_OPTIONS`).

### `resolveParams`

```ts
function resolveParams(shape: ShapeData, overrides?: Readonly<Record<string, ParamValue>>): Record<string, ParamValue>
```

Parameter defaults merged with `overrides`, type- and range-checked.

### `roundHalfEven`

```ts
function roundHalfEven(v: number): number
```

Round half to even (banker's rounding) on a finite double.

## Classes

### `DeqError`

```ts
class DeqError
```

The only error type the library throws. `code` is stable; `message` is for people.

- `name: 'DeqError'`
- `code: DeqErrorCode`
- `issues: readonly string[]`: Validation problems, one line each (for `INVALID_OPTIONS`).

### `CompositionPart`

```ts
interface CompositionPart
```

One shape placed in a composition.

- `shape: string`: Catalog shape id.
- `params?: Readonly<Record<string, ParamValue>> | undefined`: Parameter values of that shape.
- `transform?: UseTransform | undefined`: Placement: `p' = R(rotate) * (scale * (p - origin)) + origin + translate`.
- `layer?: string`: Layer id for this part. Default: the shape id.

### `RenderOptions`

```ts
interface RenderOptions
```

Options accepted by `render` and `compose`. Every option is optional; see
`DEFAULT_OPTIONS` for the defaults.

- `size?: number`: Output width and height in px. Default 24.
- `color?: string`: Stroke and dot colour (CSS colour). Default `currentColor`.
- `strokeWidth?: number`: Stroke width in grid units. Default 2.
- `absoluteStrokeWidth?: boolean`: Keep the stroke `strokeWidth` px wide at any `size`. Default false.
- `fill?: string`: Fill for closed outlines (circles, polygons, closed paths). Default `none`.
- `fillOpacity?: number`: Opacity of `fill`, 0 to 1. Default 1.
- `strokeOpacity?: number`: Opacity of the ink (strokes and dots), 0 to 1. Default 1.
- `linecap?: 'round' | 'butt' | 'square'`: Default `round`.
- `linejoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'`: Default `round`.
- `dotScale?: number`: Multiplies every dot radius. Default 1.
- `rotation?: number`: Degrees clockwise about the canvas centre. Default 0.
- `flipX?: boolean`: Mirror left to right. Default false.
- `flipY?: boolean`: Mirror top to bottom. Default false.
- `padding?: number`: Extra space around the 24 x 24 canvas, in grid units. Default 0.
- `background?: string`: Background colour painted behind the shape, or `none`. Default `none`.
- `layerColors?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>`: Colour per layer id, overriding `color` for that layer.
- `title?: string`: Accessible title. Default: the shape's English name. `""` marks the image decorative.
- `ariaLabel?: string`: Accessible label. Default: the title.
- `params?: Readonly<Record<string, ParamValue>>`: Shape parameter values, for example `{ rays: 9 }`. Default: each parameter's default.

## Types

### `Count`

```ts
type Count = number | { readonly param: string }
```

A count, either fixed or read from a parameter.

### `DeqErrorCode`

```ts
type DeqErrorCode = "UNKNOWN_SHAPE" | "INVALID_OPTIONS" | "INVALID_PARAMETER" | "INVALID_SHAPE" | "LIMIT_EXCEEDED"
```

Why an operation failed.

### `Flat`

```ts
type Flat = FlatPoly | FlatCircle | FlatArc | FlatEllipse | FlatPath
```

One drawable item in canvas units.

### `Paint`

```ts
type Paint = "stroke" | "fill"
```

How a closed primitive is painted.

### `ParamValue`

```ts
type ParamValue = number | boolean | string
```

A shape parameter value.

### `ParameterDecl`

```ts
type ParameterDecl = | { readonly type: "integer"; readonly min: number; readonly max: number; readonly default: number; readonly description: string; } | { readonly type: "boolean"; readonly default: boolean; readonly description: string } | { readonly type: "enum"; readonly values: readonly string[]; readonly default: string; readonly description: string; }
```

A shape-specific parameter declaration.

### `Params`

```ts
type Params = Readonly<Record<string, ParamValue>>
```

Parameter values by name.

### `Primitive`

```ts
type Primitive = | LinePrimitive | PolylinePrimitive | PolygonPrimitive | PathPrimitive | CirclePrimitive | DotPrimitive | ArcPrimitive | EllipsePrimitive | RectPrimitive | StarPrimitive | RadialPrimitive | RepeatPrimitive | ConcentricPrimitive | UsePrimitive
```

One typed element of a shape.

### `Segment`

```ts
type Segment = | readonly ["M", Vec] | readonly ["L", Vec] | readonly ["Q", Vec, Vec] | readonly ["C", Vec, Vec, Vec] | readonly ["Z"]
```

A path segment with absolute points.

### `Vec`

```ts
type Vec = readonly [number, number]
```

A point or vector in grid units.
